title: common/pkg/hooks: TestBadFile and TestInvalidCurrentJSON fail with Go 1.27
body:
### Description
When running tests with Go 1.27, `TestBadFile` and `TestInvalidCurrentJSON` in `common/pkg/hooks/read_test.go` fail because the error string produced by `encoding/json` has changed.

### Root Cause
In Go 1.27, `encoding/json.UnmarshalTypeError` no longer prefixes the field name with the enclosing struct name in this unmarshaling context, returning `.hook` instead of `Hook.hook`:

* **Go ≤ 1.26:**
  `json: cannot unmarshal string into Go struct field Hook.hook of type specs.Hook`
* **Go ≥ 1.27:**
  `json: cannot unmarshal string into Go struct field .hook of type specs.Hook`

Because the tests use strict regex matching expecting `Hook.hook`, they fail on Go 1.27.

### Steps to Reproduce
From repository root:
```bash
GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.27.0 go test -v ./common/pkg/hooks -run 'Test(BadFile|InvalidCurrentJSON)'
```

### Failure Output
```text
=== RUN   TestBadFile
    read_test.go:70: 
        	Error Trace:	common/pkg/hooks/read_test.go:70
        	Error:      	Expect "parsing hook "/tmp/.../hook.json": 1.0.0: json: cannot unmarshal string into Go struct field .hook of type specs.Hook" to match "^parsing hook "[^"]*hook.json": 1.0.0: json: cannot unmarshal string into Go struct field Hook.hook of type specs.Hook$"
        	Test:       	TestBadFile
--- FAIL: TestBadFile (0.00s)
=== RUN   TestInvalidCurrentJSON
    read_test.go:112: 
        	Error Trace:	common/pkg/hooks/read_test.go:112
        	Error:      	Expect "1.0.0: json: cannot unmarshal string into Go struct field .hook of type specs.Hook" to match "^1.0.0: json: cannot unmarshal string into Go struct field Hook.hook of type specs.Hook$"
        	Test:       	TestInvalidCurrentJSON
--- FAIL: TestInvalidCurrentJSON (0.00s)
```

### Proposed Fix
Relax the regex pattern in `common/pkg/hooks/read_test.go` (lines 70 and 112) so it accepts both formats:
```go
`(Hook)?\.hook`
```

*(Discovered in Debian during the Go 1.27 archive rebuild: [Debian Bug #1146190](https://bugs.debian.org/1146190))*
